text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I'm on day duty tomorrow,
so I'll be a little late for training after school.

"—The day after hearing that story,
I spotted her hard at work.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: What? You've already finished changing the water in the vases and wiping down the teacher's podium?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes. I had some free time, so...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You could have just told me.
I'm on duty today, too.
choice_data_list: (Was there some kind of misunderstanding? I hope she's okay…)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No,
it wasn't something big enough to ask for help with.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Should I have called out to her?
I'm sorry, Right O-sa—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Why are you apologizing?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who should apologize.
I left far too much for you to do alone.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah, no...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Or rather,
I should have done it sooner.
I feel bad for making you do it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
From now on, let's subtract what Believe already did
and divide the rest up fairly.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If we decide everything from the start,
we won't need to report to each other every single time!
It'll save unnecessary time!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: In other words, we can both focus on our own work. How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, yes...!
Then let's go with that."
Feeling worried, I peeked into the classroom every now and then. And then...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Alright, fishbowl cleaning complete.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Next up is restocking the chalk.
Let's dash to the staff room!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Fourth period is social studies, so...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Go to the archive room and get the blackboard map."
This is my job... Yep.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah.........!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Accelerating once more out of the corner—!!
choice_data_list: (We passed each other without saying a word...!)

text_block_list.text:
Growing concerned, I check in on Believe.
However, to my surprise...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-san's handling things solidly. With this, I can focus entirely on my own job..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, this feels comfortable to do.

And so, after school.
When I went to check on them again...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Vacuuming the blackboard erasers, done.
Believe, how about the logbook?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I've already finished writing it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Now all that's left is for me to deliver this to the faculty room.
Good work. Dismissed.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, good work today.
Thank you so much for everything.
choice_data_list: All that worrying was for nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Trainer.
Come to think of it, you came to watch earlier too, didn't you?

Putting that aside, however...
I expressed my admiration for their work.
This kind of approach is...
choice_data_list: Being efficient makes things fast, huh!
Being efficient makes things fast, doesn't it!

text_block_list.text:
Putting that aside, however...
I expressed my admiration for their work.
This kind of approach is...
choice_data_list: Being efficient makes things fast, huh!
Being efficient makes things fast, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
More than just efficient, Believe is truly capable.
Her work is both fast and meticulous.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no, it's nothing major.
...If you'll excuse me, I should be going.

Believe walked away looking slightly embarrassed.
Meanwhile, Calstone Light O kept showering her back with straightforward praise!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: What does it mean to "be yourself"?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We thought we were just doing things normally,
but are you saying there's something not normal, something unique to us?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Um, you really shouldn't
trouble Trainer-san too much...
Believe backed her up, but Calstone Light O still wore a puzzled expression.
